name: code-sample
text:
% model parameters
v0 = 20;       % m/s
g  = 9.81;     % m/s^2

% array of times
t = linspace(0,4,11);

% height at every time
y = v0.*t - 0.5*g.*t.^2;

plot(t,y,'LineWidth',2)
y(1)            % boundary check
